messages:
Priya: Quick postmortem follow-up 12. We need concrete owners for the rollout/canary/flag fixes (auto-rollback, blast-radius controls, and recurring incident patterns). Please TL;DR your ownership and ETA.

Oliver: I volunteer to own auto-rollback core behavior and the API hooks. ETA: 2026-04-08 for an initial PR to staging. Blocker: need schema signoff for rollback policy.

Ben: I'll take feature-flag blast-radius & region gating. Plan: proposal doc by 2026-03-28, schema PR by 2026-04-04.

Claire: I'll handle canary metrics + SLO definitions and add dashboards/alerts. ETA: 2026-03-31 for dashboard links.

deploy-bot: Available deploy window: 2026-04-07 02:00-04:00 UTC. Please attach `pre-deploy-checklist` to PRs.

Priya: Assigning tickets: PMF-7001 -> Oliver (auto-rollback), PMF-7002 -> Ben (flag gating), PMF-7003 -> Claire (canary metrics). Add timelines and PR links to the ticket.

Oliver: Rollback policy sketch (to be formalized):
```json
{
  "type": "auto_rollback",
  "enabled": true,
  "conditions": {
    "min_requests": 250,
    "failure_rate_pct": 1.5,
    "p95_delta_ms": 50,
    "window_sec": 300,
    "consecutive_windows": 2
  },
  "max_blast_radius_pct": 3
}
```

Ben: Flag gating sketch (yaml):
```yaml
flag: new_cache_layer
stages:
  - pct: 1
    regions: [us-east-1]
  - pct: 5
    regions: [us-east-1, eu-west-1]
safety:
  min_requests: 300
  auto_rollback: true
  error_threshold: 0.02
  p95_threshold_ms: 40
```

Claire: Acceptance criteria for canary stages: sample_size >= min_requests AND (error_rate < threshold AND p95 <= baseline + delta). If sample_size not met, mark stage as "insufficient data" and continue at operator discretion.

SRE Oncall: Ops asks: ensure rollback emits an indexed event with fields: route, variant_from, variant_to, reason, metrics_snapshot, timestamp. Keep 90d retention and index on route + variant for quick querying.

Oliver: Will emit `rollback.triggered` event and add retention note to PMF-7001.

Ben: Also adding UI control to pause auto-rollback during maintenance windows (audit-logged). Will include in PMF-7002.

Priya: Quick checklist for tickets: owner, ETA, PR link, runbook updates (post-deploy checks), telemetry event schema, smoke test plan. Put the first-run owner (who runs first 3 canaries) in ticket description.

Claire: I've added dashboard templates and a composite alert: "canary-failure-composite" = error_rate breach OR p95 regression. Linked in PMF-7003.

Oliver: PR opened (draft): https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2992. Needs schema signoff from Ben + Claire.

Ben: Proposal doc at https://docs.redwood.com/flag-gating-proposal (WIP). PR will follow after design review.

SRE Oncall: Reminder: add `deployment-checklist` label to any PR that touches rollback/flag/canary logic. Also schedule a 30m dry-run with SRE before prod rollout.

Priya: Thanks. I'll track these in the postmortem follow-up board and bring status to next ops sync (2026-04-13). If anything slips, update the ticket and ping me. :thumbsup:

Oliver: Noted. Will update PMF-7001 with ETA changes if anything pops.

Ben: Tied in. Will post PR link when ready.

Claire: Marking PMF-7003 as in progress. Linking dashboards now.

deploy-bot: Please remember to include `runbook-update` label on PRs that add or modify rollout logic.

Priya: Closing thread. Leave comments in the tickets for details.
